component.name: Wave
component.summary: Record, edit, restore and mix audio

description.p: Wave is the audio studio of the desktop: a waveform and spectral editor, multitrack sessions with a mixer, restoration and loudness tools. It is made for podcasts, voice work, audio for video and restoring old recordings, and it works entirely offline.

ul.li: Sample accurate waveform editing with markers, fades, zero crossing snapping and unlimited undo
Spectral view with rectangle, lasso and brush selections, attenuation and healing
Multitrack sessions with crossfades, buses, sends, automation and a video reference track
Equalizers, dynamics, reverb, delay, modulation, pitch and time tools, plus LV2, CLAP and LADSPA plugins in a separate process
Noise reduction, click, hum, clipping and reverb repair
EBU R128 loudness metering, normalisation and batch processing
Podcast templates with automatic ducking and local transcription
WAV and BWF, FLAC, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, AIFF and M4A with metadata and chapters
